aiEthicsDisclosure.title: AI Ethics Disclosure
aiEthicsDisclosure.description: This taxonomy documents categories of information that digital systems may collect or process. Inclusion does not imply that this application collects every category.
principles: No collection without a clearly documented purpose

dataCollectionCategories.title: Device Data
dataCollectionCategories.description: Information about the device being used.

dataCollectionCategories.title: Location Data
dataCollectionCategories.description: Location information depending on permissions and service configuration.

dataCollectionCategories.title: Usage Data
dataCollectionCategories.description: Information describing how users interact with systems.

dataCollectionCategories.title: Behavioral Data
dataCollectionCategories.description: Information used for personalization or analytics.

dataCollectionCategories.title: Communications
dataCollectionCategories.description: Communication content when provided by the service.
dataCollectionCategories.note: Access depends on system architecture, encryption, permissions, and organizational policy.

dataCollectionCategories.title: AI Interaction Data
dataCollectionCategories.description: Information generated through interaction with AI systems.
dataCollectionCategories.note: Retention and use vary by provider, deployment, and user settings.

dataCollectionCategories.title: Sensor Data
dataCollectionCategories.description: Information from device sensors when permissions are granted.
dataCollectionCategories.note: Most operating systems require user permission before access.

dataCollectionCategories.title: Metadata
dataCollectionCategories.description: Contextual information describing communications and activity rather than their contents.
dataCollectionCategories.note: Metadata can reveal significant behavioral patterns even without access to message content.

infrastructureTelemetry.title: Data Center Infrastructure Monitoring
infrastructureTelemetry.description: Operational telemetry collected to maintain infrastructure reliability, efficiency, and security.
